description:
modules/workforce — GET /api/staff-pool/ (#4709) at a school of a released
Träger: the binding of the tenant transaction, whether the Träger keeps its
staff in moto, the Springer of the week, their blocks and the status of
their Nachweise through the functions of ADR 0248, one statement each. Flat
in the number of Springer, blocks and Nachweise.
